items.summary: Unauthenticated remote takeover of Oracle E-Business Suite Workflow, exploitable over HTTP with no privileges or user interaction. Fixed in Oracle's October 2026 Critical Patch Update; EBS versions 12.2.3 to 12.2.15 are affected.

Improper authentication in Microsoft's AAD App Proxy lets an unauthorized attacker elevate privileges over the network without authentication. One of several CVSS 10.0 flaws disclosed in the October 2026 round of Microsoft advisories.

Unrestricted file upload in the WordPress MapSVG plugin (through 8.16.1) allows an attacker with low privileges to upload a web shell to the server. Site owners should update MapSVG past 8.16.1 immediately.

PHP remote code execution flaw in how out-of-memory errors unwind request handling via longjmp, leaving request memory uninitialized before a later allocation. Disclosed October 21 alongside a companion PHP flaw, with working exploits reported circulating; patch PHP at once.

PHP remote code execution flaw where global state pointing into freed request memory is not properly reset, letting a subsequent request reuse that memory. Disclosed October 21 with CVE-2026-109618; SANS raised InfoCon to Yellow over the pair.
